# biznetgio_baremetal_elastic_storage (Resource)

NEO Elastic Storage - block storage yang ke-bind permanen ke satu baremetal saat create (gak bisa pindah server).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "biznetgio_baremetal_elastic_storage" "main" {
  product_id       = 1
  cycle            = "m"
  storage_name     = "data-volume"
  metal_account_id = 12345
  size             = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cycle` (String) Siklus billing, misal `m` (monthly) atau `a` (annual).
- `metal_account_id` (Number) Account id baremetal target. Cuma bisa di-set pas create (no re-attach endpoint).
- `product_id` (Number) Product id dari `GET /baremetal-neo-elastic-storages/products`. Kalau berubah, provider panggil change-package (`POST .../{account_id}`).
- `storage_name` (String) Nama storage.

### Optional

- `pay_with_credit_card` (Boolean) Bayar invoice pake kartu kredit saat order/upgrade. Default true (auto-charge). Set false kalau mau ninggalin invoice unpaid di portal - resource bakal stuck Pending sampai dibayar.
- `promocode` (String) Kode promo.
- `size` (Number) Ukuran storage dalam GB. Default 100. Kalau berubah, provider panggil upgrade (`PUT .../{account_id}`) - grow-only, set lebih kecil bakal ditolak API.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (Number) Account id elastic storage di BiznetGIO.
- `created_at` (String) Tanggal dibuat (alias created_at/date_created).
- `id` (String) Resource id = account_id storage.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON response terakhir dari API.
- `status` (String) Status storage (misal Active, Pending, Suspended, Terminated).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import biznetgio_baremetal_elastic_storage.main <account_id>
```
